creative.audience: Indian bank and credit card users
creative.logline: Scattered statements become a private, understandable ledger.
creative.viewer_outcome: Understand the product and statement import-to-insight workflow.
creative.visual_style: Private ledger: ink, paper, mint, Inter, restrained editorial motion.

narration.voice_profile: Kokoro v1.0 af_heart, local ONNX synthesis, conversational English

segments.text: Bank statements. Card bills. So many transactions. Where does your money actually go?
segments.delivery: Warm, measured; leave a breath at the end.

segments.text: Meet Local Finance. A private, offline workspace for your Indian bank accounts and credit cards.
segments.delivery: Warm, measured; leave a breath at the end.

segments.text: Start with a supported PDF, CSV, or Excel statement. Preview the transactions, then import. Local Finance reads and organizes the records on your computer.
segments.delivery: Warm, measured; leave a breath at the end.

segments.text: Rules help categorize spending. Add tags and notes. Reimport the same statement without duplicates. Your edits stay.
segments.delivery: Warm, measured; leave a breath at the end.

segments.text: See spending by category, follow your cash flow, and compare monthly totals. Set category budgets to track spending against the limits you choose.
segments.delivery: Warm, measured; leave a breath at the end.

segments.text: The app and its database run locally. Your financial records stay on your machine. No cloud sync, no bank connection. Public release checks are optional.
segments.delivery: Warm, measured; leave a breath at the end.

segments.text: Import. Review. Understand. Local Finance. Your money, made clear.
segments.delivery: Warm, measured; leave a breath at the end.
